summary: Bump the changelog-derived project version from 0.4.0 to 0.4.1 and record the installer parity feature and the missing-vlan installation fix under that heading. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Every page carrying a current-working-version label now names development product 0.4.1, so the guide does not describe a version older than the one a local build stamps.

api.reason: Version metadata only; the installer changes under this heading carry their own assessments and add no Controller/Core contract.

roadmap.reason: No phase or publication claim. 0.4.1 is a working-tree heading for installer work; the Phase 4 acceptance scope recorded under 0.4.0 is unchanged.

state.reason: Version metadata adds no durable product state.

verification.method: python3 scripts/release-version.py --current --format both returns '0.4.1 0.4.1' and python3 -m unittest tests.test_release_version passed (10 tests) on 2026-09-21. The 0.4.0 section keeps its committed Phase 4 entries and acceptance note unchanged; the two new installer entries were moved under the 0.4.1 heading and [Unreleased] is still empty. The eight current-working-version labels that read 0.4.0 were bumped together. No 0.4.1 ISO was built, tagged or published, and no installation was performed.
